name: song-ngan
description: Let Claude see your Google Classroom: classes, assignments, due dates, attached files and grades. Runs only on your computer.
long_description: SongNgan connects Claude to your own Google Classroom account. Ask what is due this week, get assignment instructions, read attached PDFs, Docs and Slides, check grades, and optionally upload files, turn in work and add due dates to Google Calendar. Your Google token stays in your computer's keychain; nothing passes through a third-party server.

client_secret.title: client_secret.json
client_secret.description: Desktop OAuth client downloaded from Google Cloud Console. See the setup guide.

enable_files.title: Read attached files
enable_files.description: Allow reading PDFs, Docs, Slides and Sheets attached to assignments (Google Drive read-only).

enable_write.title: Write actions
enable_write.description: Allow uploading to Drive, attaching files, turning in work and adding due dates to Google Calendar.
